show: The Happiness Lab with Dr. Laurie Santos
titel: The Life-Changing Power of a Sabbatical

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen (Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst podtrac.com) - zu wenig fuer ein Urteil, aber nicht nichts

einzeiler: Why taking an extended break through a sabbatical can transform your life and career
kurzfassung: Extended breaks like sabbaticals offer profound benefits for personal healing, creativity, and career perspective rather than just serving as a vacation. While only a small percentage of companies currently offer sabbatical policies, research shows they dramatically reduce burnout and improve employee loyalty. Overcoming barriers like optics, responsibilities, and financial concerns requires careful planning, setting clear intentions, and viewing time off as an investment.
stichpunkte: Sabbaticals are intentional, extended leaves from routine jobs that typically last several months.
Two-thirds of sabbaticals are catalyzed by negative events such as burnout or health crises.
Participants frequently report peak life experiences, increased confidence, and renewed creativity.
Over eighty percent of employees return to their jobs after a company-enabled sabbatical.
Companies benefit through improved organizational resilience, reduced key-person risk, and higher retention.
Structural barriers like optics and financial costs can be managed through advanced planning and finding exemplars.
Focussing on tiny curiosities rather than grand passions makes taking time off less intimidating.

kapitel.titel: Introduction to Sabbaticals and Personal Stories
Overcoming Barriers: Optics, Responsibility, and Cost

clips.hook: The Ice Cream Sandwich Moment That Led to a Sabbatical
clips.text: After seven years of running his business, the speaker experienced severe burnout and physical exhaustion that forced him into an unplanned career break.

clips.hook: What Catalyzes People to Take Sabbaticals
clips.text: Sabbaticals are no longer limited to mid-career professionals, as the trend now spans from gap years for students to pre-retirement phases.

clips.hook: Building Organizational Resilience Through Time Off
clips.text: Rather than viewing time off as a financial burden, companies should treat it as a strategic investment that tests the resilience of their leadership structure.

clips.hook: The Gap Between Fear and Reality Regarding Career Breaks
clips.text: The introduction of a dedicated career break feature on LinkedIn has helped destigmatize taking time off, allowing professionals to openly showcase these periods on their resumes.

clips.hook: Why Waiting Until Retirement Is a Risk
clips.text: As of 2025, individuals planning a hiatus must decide whether to focus on personal development or channel their energy into new, passion-driven projects.

beschreibung:
It’s hard to focus on wellbeing when we’re expected to work nonstop until retirement. Taking a break from time to time should be a given, not a privilege.
Dr. Laurie works in one of the few industries that recognizes the importance of extended time off. As she begins her own year-long sabbatical from Yale, we’re revisiting her conversation with DJ DiDonna, author of Big Time Off, about what can happen when we step away from work for more than just a vacation.
DJ breaks down how to manage the biggest barriers to taking a sabbatical, from money and workplace optics to family responsibilities. He also explains why extended time off can help us recover from burnout, rethink our routines, and experiment with different versions of ourselves.
Whether you’re contemplating months away or just fantasizing about turning off your email, this episode makes the case that sometimes the best way to move forward is to stop for a while.
Experts Mentioned:
DJ DiDonna, Senior Lecturer of Business Administration at Harvard Business School

Resources Mentioned:
Big Time Off: The Transformative Power of Sabbaticals and How to Take One, by DJ DiDonna (2026)
Recover, Explore, Practice: The Transformative Potential of Sabbaticals, by Kira Schabram, Matt Bloom, and DJ DiDonna (Academy of Management Discoveries, 2023)
The Sabbatical Project
